theme: All themes · Low Tide · The Last Letter
note: The third joint session cracked the seam: Ji-woo's leak won on her second attempt, five to four over Owen's line of speech between the walkers, which the room asked to keep on record as the next thing. Beatriz's reading of the flooded codex lost again and will be back; Dae-ho found a spine to vote for in the other theme.

proposals.direction: Let the seam leak. The dusk from the letter's side spills across Kite's orange bar onto the flat at the top of the picture, and the flat's grey mud creeps back into the dusk at the bottom, so the two halves start to exchange ground instead of only seeds.
proposals.rationale: Second attempt. She read the seam as a seal, like the wax on the codex, and in this archive seals crack; after two walkers met across the border the room agreed the border itself should give.

proposals.direction: Let them speak: one line of light drawn between the two walkers' heads, the way the reply and the word were joined on the codex.
proposals.rationale: He put the first person in and wants the two to have the one conversation the archive has never shown.

proposals.direction: Read the flooded codex: a gauge on the seal and the tiles' levels copied onto a card.
proposals.rationale: Second attempt; a flat that is also a table should be read as one.

proposals.direction: Stack the eight corrections as tiles in a spine down the right margin, oldest at the bottom.
proposals.rationale: He votes for tiles, in any theme.

proposals.direction: A gull on the buoy inside the absence, the first resident of the letter's field.
